item: FR2-11 Full action history (AUDIT-2, after fix-1; branch claude/fr2-11-action-history @ 4604e3a)
escalation_note: Second failed independent audit. Per the escalation rule the builder should stop patching shapes, re-derive the root cause, and propose a revised plan before writing code. A third failure means BLOCKED.
root_cause_hypothesis: redactHistoryText is not fail-closed. It only cuts tokens that match an enumerated list of URL markers: scheme://, a leading //, a dotted/IPv4/IPv6/localhost host followed by / ? #, user:pass@, data:, a ?key= query, or a k=v&k= form. A URL-bearing token outside that list keeps its ? and # tail. Examples: a scheme with no // (com.example.app:/cb, about:blank), a single-label host:port (intranet:8080/p), and a URL containing a literal space. The implementation is at fault, not the spec: spec 0.7 requires FR2-09 D5 URL redaction on every URL-bearing string, including inside verification text. The tests are also incomplete (A2-F3).

findings.title: The fragment or query of a URL whose scheme has no // leaks through real browser/Puppeteer strings on every surface, including on disk
findings.repro: browser.navigate {url:'com.example.app:/cb#access_token=S'} then get_action_history: entry.error contains '#access_token=S' (CLI: 'sutradhar nav com.example.app:/cb#access_token=S' puts it in history.jsonl and in 'sutradhar history'). Also browser.navigate {url:'about:blank#S'}: verification.reason and evidence.detail contain '#S'.
findings.note: com.example.app:/path is the RFC 8252 private-use-scheme redirect form. A multi-parameter fragment (&token_type=) and ?code= are cut; a single-parameter fragment and a no-'=' tail are not. The same URL is redacted in target/url and leaked in error/reason.

findings.title: Docs, --help and the tool description over-claim the rule (F4 recurrence)
findings.repro: redactHistoryText('see intranet:8080/p?S') and redactHistoryText('https://x.test/my dir#S') are returned unchanged; 'https://x.test/cb?q=ab S&next=https://y.test/' keeps 'S&next='; '//fileserver/share/S/f.txt' is kept whole (UNC claimed -> basename); 'file:/home/S/f.txt', 'path:/home/S/f.txt' and the tilde-backslash form are kept.

rulings.expect_text_storage: Legitimate verification evidence, and not a Done-when or FR2-07 D1/D11 violation. D11 covers page FIELD values and clipboard contents; expect.text is the caller's own expectation. The action result already returns it, and it is scrubbed to <value> when it equals the typed value (verified live). It IS written to disk in CLI actions[].verification.evidence.expected, and that is documented in the README, AGENT_SETUP, the MCP README and the changelog. Residual risk: --expect-text <OTP or account number> writes it to history.jsonl. Recommended, not required: a length-only mode, or dropping expected on pass.
rulings.cwd: Acceptable as documented (GAP-359): it is a spec'd field, state.json in the same user-only directory already stores it. But it survives 'close' and holds the username and project path. Recommend storing it home-relative (~/...) or as the directory hash.
rulings.F6_handle_dialog: Neither is a Done-when violation. The Done-when does not require recording pre-dispatch rejections or dialogs; spec N4 classes rejections before tab resolution as not an action, and FR2-06 R2 pins zero resolveTab calls. handle_dialog is outside the recorded set in spec 0.2. Both are documented (GAP-356 / GAP-357). The inconsistency with engine-level invalid-CSS rejections, which ARE recorded, is noted but not blocking.
